name: Student Residency

qualifying_event.description: Enrollment in a Jordanian university (or school, for minors) supports an application for student residency through the Public Security Directorate.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Study/enrollment confirmation letter from the institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmation of enrollment at a Jordanian university.
Confirmation of enrollment at a Jordanian school.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable for duration of study

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: student residency is free of charge for both university and school students on submission of a study/enrollment confirmation

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- thin. PSD's own service listing confirms the student residency category exists and is fee-free, but no further procedural detail (processing time beyond the generic 15-minute service-counter figure, work-rights-while-studying policy, post-graduation transition specifics) was found in this pass. Whether student residency counts toward the 10-year cumulative residence threshold for jo_permanent_residence was not confirmed and is not assumed.
